threejs_runtime_notes: Three.js GLTFLoader sanitizes node and bone names using THREE.PropertyBinding.sanitizeNodeName() (e.g. 'handslot.r' -> 'handslotr', 'Shoulder.L' -> 'ShoulderL', 'Bip01 Pelvis' -> 'Bip01_Pelvis'). Always resolve bone names or pass SkeletonUtils.retargetClip bone maps through sanitizeNodeName().

When disposing loaded SkinnedMesh characters, explicitly call obj.skeleton.dispose() alongside geometry, material, and material texture disposal; omitting skeleton.dispose() leaks one GPU boneTexture per SkinnedMesh reload cycle (empirically verified in Chromium/WebGL2).

quaternius-umw-62.retargeting_warning: Rotation-only Three.js SkeletonUtils.retargetClip from FK-foot rigs (UAL1/UAL2) leaves Foot.L and Foot.R anchored at Root origin while legs bend, visibly stretching calves/boots (observed in Chromium QA case 15_retarget_ual1_to_umw_adventurer). Treat UMW as incompatible with FK rotation-only retargeting unless converted to FK feet or driving foot IK targets.

retargeting_workflows.verified_in_chromium: 17_retarget_ual1_to_kaykit_knight (Visual inspection confirmed clean Jog_Fwd_Loop leg/arm stride without mesh twist or clipping).
retargeting_workflows.method: SkeletonUtils.retargetClip with explicit UAL_TO_KAYKIT bone map, computed bind-pose world rotation offsets (R_src^-1 * R_dst), preservePosition=false, and strip '.position' tracks (rotation-only retarget preserves stylized KayKit limb proportions).

retargeting_workflows.verified_in_chromium: 16_retarget_ual1_to_rocketbox_male01 (Legs/torso/head stride cleanly; minor left-forearm inward tuck noted from Bip01 rest-pose roll / A-to-T pose offset).
retargeting_workflows.method: SkeletonUtils.retargetClip with UAL_TO_ROCKETBOX map, computed rest-pose localOffsets, strip '.position' tracks, AND restore target bone scales after retargetClip so Bip01's 0.01 parent scale does not leave 100x scale matrices on child bones.

retargeting_workflows.verified_in_chromium: 15_retarget_ual1_to_umw_adventurer (Visual inspection showed detached IK Foot.L/R remaining anchored at floor origin while legs moved, stretching boots vertically).
retargeting_workflows.recommendation: Use the 24 native UMW clips included in Individual Characters/*.glb and UMW_Animations.glb, or bake FK foot hierarchy in Blender before retargeting.

incompatible_pairs_explicit.reason: Completely disjoint bone counts (23 vs 65), naming (.l/.r vs UE _l/_r), and rest proportions; requires explicit rotation-only retargeting.
Translation curves in Rig_Large are scaled for larger proportions; keep clips paired to their own Rig_Medium / Rig_Large family unless retargeted.
